map.布氏(HB)、洛氏(HRC/HRB)、维氏(HV)硬度换算，依据 ASTM E1: Brinell (HB), Rockwell (HRC/HRB) and Vickers (HV) hardness conversion using approximate values per ASTM E140 / GB/T 33362.
map.硬度换算（ASTM E140 / GB/T 33362 近似）：以线性插值在标准: Hardness conversion (ASTM E140 / GB/T 33362 approximation): convert Brinell HB, Rockwell HRC/HRB and Vickers HV by linear interpolation on the standard reference table; hardness on different scales for the same material corresponds to the same tensile strength band, so HRC 20 corresponds to about HB 238 and HV 247, and HRC 40 to about HB 371 and HV 392.

Hardness conversion (ASTM E140 / GB/T 33362 approximation): linear interpolation on a standard comparison table converts Brinell HB, Rockwell HRC/HRB and Vickers HV; different scales for the same material map to the same tensile-strength range, e.g. HRC 20 corresponds to about HBW 225 and HV 226, and HRC 40 to about HBW 380 and HV 392. Calibrated ranges: HRC 20–68, HBW 100–760, HV 100–940, HRB 52–97; beyond these ranges the endpoint is used as an approximation with a notice, for reference only.
map.输入超出该标尺的标定范围，换算结果按端点近似，仅供参考。: The input is outside the calibrated range for this scale; the result is approximated at the endpoint and is for reference only.
map.HRB 仅适用于软态金属（约 HV≤150 / HRC≤20），超出此范围按表上: HRB applies only to soft metals (about HV≤150 / HRC≤20); beyond that range the table maximum is shown as an approximation.
map.HRC 适用于淬火高硬度钢（20~70）；HBW 适用于退火/正火及铸件；HV: HRC suits hardened high-hardness steel (20 to 70); HBW suits annealed or normalised steel and castings; HV has the widest applicability and converts directly to strength.
map.换算关系为非线性的经验近似，不同材料与标准存在差异，本表适用于碳钢与低合金钢。: The conversion relationship is a non-linear empirical approximation that varies by material and standard, so this table applies to carbon steel and low-alloy steel.
map.图纸标注一种硬度标尺、来料只有另一种标尺读数时，查 ASTM E140 对照表插: When drawings specify one hardness scale but incoming material only has a reading on another, interpolate between them using the ASTM E140 reference table.
map.经验估算材料近似抗拉强度，做快速选材判断。: to estimate approximate tensile strength from material hardness for quick material selection judgements.
map.批量检测数据跨标尺归一，便于 SPC 统计与横向比较。: Normalise test data across scales in batches to make SPC statistics and cross-comparison easier.
map.常用近似对应点（与页内 DATA 表一致）：HRC 20≈HBW 225≈HV: Common approximate correspondence points (matching the DATA table on this page): HRC 20≈HBW 225≈HV 226; HRC 40≈HBW 380≈HV 392; HRC 60 (interpolated between 58 and 62)≈HBW 609≈HV 718 (carbon steel approximation; high-alloy steels deviate). Interpolation is linear between adjacent points; beyond the calibrated range (HRC 20–68) error grows and an endpoint-approximation notice is shown.
map.对退火/正火碳钢，近似抗拉强度 σb ≈ HV × 3.0（MPa）。例如 HV: For annealed or normalised carbon steel, approximate tensile strength σb ≈ HV × 3.0 (MPa). For example HV 240 gives σb≈720 MPa and HV 400 gives σb≈1200 MPa. This is an empirical relation; heat treatment state and alloying change the ratio significantly, so for formal material selection follow tensile testing.
map.硬度换算表能替代真实试验吗？: Can the hardness conversion table replace real testing?
map.不能。对照表是统计经验关系，受材料、热处理与标尺范围影响；关键件强度仍应以拉伸试: No. The table is a statistical empirical relation affected by material, heat treatment and scale range. Strength of critical parts must still be determined by tensile testing; conversion is only a quick reference.
map.为什么高合金钢偏差大？: Why do high-alloy steels deviate more?
map.合金元素改变加工硬化与基体强度，使硬度—强度比例偏移，且不同标尺对不同基体敏感度: Alloying elements change work hardening and matrix strength, shifting the hardness-to-strength ratio, and different scales respond differently to different matrices, so cross-scale error is more pronounced in high-alloy materials.
